## Clicker 1 — Albedo

Two otherwise identical planets orbit identical stars at the same distance. Planet B has a higher Bond albedo than Planet A. In this model, Planet B’s equilibrium temperature $T_{eq}$ is:

A. Higher  
B. Lower  
C. The same  
D. Not enough information

## Clicker 2 — Greenhouse strength

Two planets have the same $T_{eq}$ but different $T_{surf}$. In this model, the planet with higher $T_{surf}$ must have:

A. Higher Bond albedo  
B. Lower Bond albedo  
C. Larger $\tau_{IR}$  
D. Smaller $\tau_{IR}$

## Short answer (2–4 sentences)

Venus has a much higher Bond albedo than Earth, yet Venus’s surface temperature is far higher. Using energy-flow language, explain how this can happen in the toy model.
